title: Qualify a quantum circuit for competition entry

mission.purpose: Determine whether a reusable GF(4096) multiplier warrants pursuing the Google Quantum AI circuit competition.
mission.beneficiary: MONTREAL.AI research operator evaluating a prospective competition entry
requirements: Reconstruct the candidate and conventional controls on the same attributed rank-42 tensor.
Independently check the delivered circuit and compare qubits, Toffolis and CNOTs against the strongest measured control.
Record the contest decision separately from a verified auxiliary circuit.
